scope.definition: All active string leaves in this repository’s current classified source/runtime snapshots; explicit source offsets define audible French units.

limits: Every classified source leaf has a decision; this does not certify human auditory listening or external language proficiency.
Pure IPA and grammatical placeholders do not count as sentence audio; letter names are separately classified.
Teaching text edits require rebuilding affected source-span classifications.
Playback, offline behavior and local file validation are recorded separately in the acceptance reports.
source_hash_validation: All 4105 approved occurrences independently reconstructed from current sources with zero mismatch. No acoustic certification.
source_hash_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON (ensure_ascii=False, sorted keys, compact separators), per current actual source/runtime object; raw source_offsets use Unicode codepoints before HTML stripping.

batch2_scope.definition: Actual newly appended/changed French source leaves and mixed exact spans, complete models, answer variants, explicitly non-normative error inputs; current full dialogue composites rebuilt. Chinese, source metadata, grammatical labels and open-slot templates excluded.
